_comment: F1: identical to conditions_S8.json in every respect EXCEPT cascade, which
selects Case 1 (he_mode=1).  Case 1 carries Q_m -- a helium inventory per
size class -- so ell(m) = Q_m/c_v[m] is free to vary with m instead of being
assigned ell_bar*m^(2/3) from one scalar as Case 2 does.  That is the only
structure in the model that can put a stable small-cavity branch and a
growing large one on the same size axis.
G_He_r is deliberately ABSENT, so it keeps the workbook value of 1 appm/dpa
-- the same helium supply as every S8 run.  The comparison against the BOR-60
fission data therefore stays honest: the He FORMULATION changes, the He
SUPPLY does not.  F2 is the arm that moves the supply.

S330.label: 330 C, G=1e-7, 15 dpa, Case 1 (per-size He) at the FISSION He rate
